meta.name: llm-bench example bank
meta.purpose: Shape demonstration only. NOT the real benchmark item bank — that is A3's deliverable. Three items chosen to exercise three different scorers.
notes: Keep prompts short and self-contained: the harness prepends no system prompt unless `system` is set.
Prompts that ask for a specific output shape score far more reliably than open questions.
Every item MUST be answerable without network access or tool use.

items.prompt: Reply with exactly the following text and nothing else: PING-OK
items.notes: Calibration item. Measures instruction-adherence and the format axis. If this fails, the harness or the isolation flags are wrong — not the model.

items.prompt: What is 17 multiplied by 23? Reply with the number only, no units, no commas.
items.notes: Ground truth 17*23=391. abs_tol 0 forces an exact integer; loosen to 1e-6 for float items.

items.prompt: A train leaves at 09:00 travelling 80 km/h. A second train leaves the same station at 09:30 travelling 120 km/h on the same track. At what time does the second train catch the first? Reply in the form 'ANSWER: HH:MM'.
items.notes: First train has a 30-minute = 40 km head start; closing speed 40 km/h so the catch takes 1 h. Demonstrates a multi-token expected value with scorer_args.allowed.
